dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the wide mid-body section toward a sharp, pointed convergence at the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight symmetrical narrowing at the cervical region followed by a smooth convex expansion to the mid-body; edges are generally continuous without significant bulges.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white; high median pixel intensity consistent with a sub-adult or adult phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey patches distributed across the dorsal surface, most notably in the anterior and mid-body regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; gradual gradient transitions between the lighter baseline skin tone and the darker mottled clusters.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of fine, low-contrast linear markings running longitudinally along the mid-dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple faint, linear epidermal scratches visible on the mid-dorsal region.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced specular highlight along the posterior dorsal ridge; blowhole is clearly defined as a high-contrast dark circular aperture.
